conclusion: The strict historical replay cannot establish model accuracy, profitability, drawdown, or robustness in downturn/high-volatility conditions from this archive. This is a data-admissibility result, not evidence for or against a trading edge.

descriptive_regime_coverage.definition: Trailing 30-day endpoint return <= -5% for downturn; sample standard deviation of 720 hourly log returns * sqrt(365*24) >=80% for high volatility; require721 consecutive closes.
descriptive_regime_coverage.gap_verification: Separate Coinbase Exchange endpoint requests also lacked the ten required hourly bars. No interpolation or threshold changes.
descriptive_regime_coverage.interpretation: Zero high-volatility classifications among COMPLETE SAMPLED cutoffs only. Does not rule out high volatility in excluded windows, intraday periods or short-lived jumps. Overlapping trailing windows are dependent, not573 independent events.
descriptive_regime_coverage.source: Current-retrieval Coinbase BTC-USD hourly prices; not historical as-of model inputs and not the exact Kalshi settlement index.

diagnosis: Every selected market snapshot was already finalized. There is no selected snapshot recorded before that contract closed.
None of the selected one-minute quote records was received within the required 120-second freshness bound. The native backtester rejected the received-time records before model evaluation.
The native missing_metadata_signals counter also includes unsupported/ineligible metadata. It must not be interpreted as proof that metadata rows are literally absent.
The earliest source market metadata was recorded August 6, 2026. Downloaded older candle dates do not create contemporaneous market state or research input provenance.

No qualifying forecast exists on which to compare the structural model, blend, executable YES ask and midpoint baseline. Calibration thresholds were not the binding failure; no forecast reached that stage.

historical_venue_probe.conclusion: Some public historical data are accessible. This one-event probe is not an exhaustive availability survey, continuous one-hour coverage, or evidence of contemporaneous receipt.

limitations: No model performance under downturns or high volatility has been established by this work.
No threshold was lowered to create high-volatility samples. Broader dates or a different stress definition would require a new predeclared experiment.
The archive and experiments are retrospective and cannot establish untouched unseen-event evidence.
Fees have no preserved pre-cutoff schedule rows in this extraction; the configured fee fallback is recorded, but no trade reached execution.

Raw source SQLite remains local. Selected source rows and schema have canonical fingerprints; the mixed-period11GB backup was not given a new full-file byte hash. The published native backtest contains source-input identities, not a portable replacement for every raw database row.
next_requirements: Continue the upgraded forward collection without altering the frozen holdout or approving signals from this result.

For older periods, obtain point-in-time market/rule snapshots and quotes with defensible publication/receipt and revision provenance, plus complete timely BTC inputs. A trusted historical-provider adapter would require its own provenance review; simply backdating current downloads is not acceptable.
Require enough independent resolved events/dates and qualifying full folds in the target regimes before interpreting performance. Dates elapsed and raw scan counts do not satisfy those requirements.
Any extension to earlier stress dates, alternate volatility windows or new data semantics must be frozen as a separate experiment before scoring.

performance.reason: No admissible scored population. Native zero cash flows with zero trades are bookkeeping zeros, not measured performance.
